name: Related Settlement Instruction 3
definition: Information about a related settlement instruction.

MarketInfrastructureTransactionIdentific.name: Market Infrastructure Transaction Identification
MarketInfrastructureTransactionIdentific.definition: Identification of a transaction assigned by a market infrastructure other than a central securities depository, for example, Target2-Securities.

ProcessorTransactionIdentification.name: Processor Transaction Identification
ProcessorTransactionIdentification.definition: Identification of the transaction assigned by the processor of the instruction other than the account owner, the account servicer or the market infrastructure.

UniqueTransactionIdentifier.name: Unique Transaction Identifier
UniqueTransactionIdentifier.definition: Unique Transaction Identifier (UTI) as agreed with the other counterparty.

RelatedSettlementInstructionIdentificati.name: Related Settlement Instruction Identification
RelatedSettlementInstructionIdentificati.definition: Unambiguous identification of the related settlement instruction assigned by the account holder.

SecuritiesMovementType.name: Securities Movement Type
SecuritiesMovementType.definition: Specifies if the movement on a securities account results from a deliver or a receive instruction.

Payment.name: Payment
Payment.definition: Specifies how the transaction is to be settled, for example, against payment.

TradeDate.name: Trade Date
TradeDate.definition: Specifies the date/time on which the trade was executed.

SettlementDate.name: Settlement Date
SettlementDate.definition: Date and time at which the securities are to be delivered or received.

SettlementQuantity.name: Settlement Quantity
SettlementQuantity.definition: Total quantity of securities to be settled.

SettlementAmount.name: Settlement Amount
SettlementAmount.definition: Total amount of money to be paid or received in exchange for the securities.

CounterpartyDepository.name: Counterparty Depository
CounterpartyDepository.definition: First receiving party in the settlement chain. In a plain vanilla settlement, it is the central securities depository where the receiving side of the transaction requests to receive the financial instrument.

MarketInfrastructureOrProcessorTransacti.definition: Either MarketInfrastructureTransactionIdentification or ProcessorTransactionIdentification must be present, both may be present.
